# Verify the calculations for the orders
nav = 941168666
cash = 120863016
import math

orders = [
  {"ticker": "2376", "side": "SELL", "shares": 60000, "price": 284, "tw": 0.0, "curr": 60000},
  {"ticker": "4938", "side": "SELL", "shares": 408000, "price": 89.1, "tw": 0.0, "curr": 408000},
  {"ticker": "3034", "side": "SELL", "shares": 38000, "price": 474, "tw": 0.0, "curr": 38000},
  {"ticker": "3037", "side": "SELL", "shares": 14000, "price": 785, "tw": 0.0, "curr": 14000},
  {"ticker": "3189", "side": "SELL", "shares": 10000, "price": 668, "tw": 0.0, "curr": 10000},
  {"ticker": "3661", "side": "BUY", "shares": 5000, "price": 4020, "tw": 0.0256, "curr": 0},
  {"ticker": "2454", "side": "BUY", "shares": 6000, "price": 4120, "tw": 0.0263, "curr": 0},
  {"ticker": "6510", "side": "BUY", "shares": 4000, "price": 3335, "tw": 0.0177, "curr": 0},
  {"ticker": "2618", "side": "BUY", "shares": 490000, "price": 47.75, "tw": 0.0249, "curr": 0},
]

sell_val = 0
buy_val = 0
for o in orders:
    ts = math.floor(o["tw"] * nav / o["price"] / 1000) * 1000
    diff = ts - o["curr"]
    val = o["shares"] * o["price"]
    if o["side"] == "SELL":
        sell_val += val
    else:
        buy_val += val
    print(f"{o['ticker']}: target={ts}, diff={diff}, val={val:,.0f}")

new_cash = cash + sell_val - buy_val
print(f"Sell Val: {sell_val:,.0f}, Buy Val: {buy_val:,.0f}, New Cash: {new_cash:,.0f}, Cash %: {new_cash/nav:.4f}")
